assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: 16:9 landscape background for Felt & Fable Studio, a child-friendly animated felt-board film of Danse macabre. Create one continuous wide 16:9 view of a charming gently spooky graveyard under moonlight. Entire scene is visibly handmade from FLAT cut wool-felt sheets in shallow layered collage, with fine realistic wool fibers and crisp cut edges. NOT 3D rendered toy scenery, not Pixar, not blurry painterly art. Indigo/plum nighttime felt sky, pale cream full moon upper left, little sewn stars. Soft rounded hills, sparse gently crooked bare felt trees framing left and right edges, few small uneven lavender-gray stone gravemarkers with no letters or inscriptions around side and rear edges. A tiny old French village clock tower sits on distant right hill as scenic silhouette. Central and lower-middle broad grass clearing is EMPTY and uncluttered for animated dancing characters. Gently curved pale path at rear. Camera level, storybook theatrical wide shot; friendly shapes rather than realistic horror. Rich deep emerald/teal ground with distinct soft felt fibers; moonlight still leaves every detail clear, no black crushed shadows. No characters, skeletons, ghosts, bats, instruments, words, logos or watermark. Keep ground lower half open. Full-bleed 16:9, high clarity and beautifully tactile fabric.
assets.notes: Midnight scenic background. Broad empty central clearing; child-friendly graveyard.

assets.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the supplied felt graveyard landscape. Create its exactly matching DAWN / SUNRISE version for a continuous camera dissolve. Keep the exact same aspect ratio, framing, camera position, every tree silhouette, gravestone, stone wall, gate, path, village, tower, hill, plant and clearing in precisely the same locations and shapes. Change ONLY time of day and light: sky is softly glowing apricot peach fading to dusty rose/pale lavender, no stars; replace moon with a warm soft pale golden sun in the same upper-left sky position. Gentle sunrise washes the same emerald felt grass with warmer light and reveals the landscape clearly; graveyard becomes peaceful friendly morning. Maintain crisp tactile wool-felt fabric textures everywhere, handmade cut-felt storybook aesthetic. Keep the center/lower clearing empty and no characters or new objects. No text or watermark. Exact composition continuity is essential.
assets.notes: Matched edit. Same landmark positions for dawn transition.

assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact clock tower into a CLEAN native-transparent cutout sprite. Preserve all of the tower itself: stone shapes, roof, blank circular cream clock dial, colors, fibers and front elevation. Completely remove the entire cloudy gray/purple/gold glow surrounding the tower, all backdrop shading, outer cast shadows, haze and halo. All pixels outside the physical tower silhouette must be fully transparent, including all space left and right and above the roof finial. Tower itself should be fully opaque, sharp clean felt edges. Do not fade tower edges out and do not add any glow. No added lettering, numbers or clock hands. No white rectangle, checkerboard or ground. This is a single physical felt tower with crisp alpha silhouette, ready to place over any background.
assets.originalPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: isolated transparent-background game prop for a charming handmade wool-felt storybook animation. One small old French village CLOCK TOWER, front elevation, upright and centered, full tower visible with clear transparent margin around all edges. Native transparent alpha background, no white ground or backdrop. Flat layered cut wool-felt collage in lavender-gray felt stone blocks, slate indigo pointed roof, one copper/brass circular rim around a plain cream round clock dial centered on upper front of tower. The dial is a perfectly front-facing CIRCLE, completely BLANK: absolutely NO clock hands, no numbers, no tick marks, no lettering. Animator will overlay accurate moving hands and numbers. Large dial about one third tower width. Tower is cute storybook shape gently tapered, not threatening. Small dark arched window lower down and closed dark wooden door at base. Flat colored felt layers, crisp scissor-cut edges, delicate wool fibers, subtle layer contact shading. No strong 3D geometry, no perspective angle, no plush toy, no photoreal architecture. Match cozy gently spooky felt-board graveyard palette. No characters, ground plane, cast shadow outside cutout, extra objects, logos or text. Portrait composition single tower, round blank cream dial
assets.notes: Native alpha, no erasure. Clock dial intentionally blank. Dial center approx (512,737) in1024x1536; inner radius137px, rimradius158px. Use code hands/numerals. Alpha preview separately composited only for QA.
